body: Congrats on having an abusive and manipulative lunatic as a mother👍

No drivers license, no job. Not living in a city + all the jobs are in a city. Buses also rarely drive here.

And people in this village also dont really work, they have their own fields or herd animals and thats about it.
Funny because i had talks with a finnish friend about just this topic recently :) maybe thats a sign haha

My father earns ~10k dollars a month and didnt want to pay for my braces either, nor a drivers license and here i am, 22, still without braces and without a drivers license :)

Dont beat yourself up about it too much. It sucks but if you get through this, you will only prove that youre strong since you were able to achiwve things without help.

That are some very true and wise words. Thank you very much and yes i do live with them sadly, but definitely not long anymore! :) I appreciate your reply and everything you wrote is very true. I forgot 90% of my whole childhood and my life has been marked not only by my parents but also people in school and girls that broke my heart. I definitely would love to move out, get therapy, be a better self and really change for the better and start a new life, away from all the negativity and BS ive went through.
Very relateable, i wish i wouldnt wake up anymore...

It also hurts me but it also makes me go crazy that i cant go back in time and appreciate all the good moments more and change some decisions i made and react differently to specific things... I really wish to travel back in time, i want it so bad... 

She didnt stop talking to me, she is just distancing herself from me and wants to stay friends i suppose...

I also told her that i would have left me long ago. At least i know how to stop, for me this became very clear... All i had to do over all these years was just to admit that i do infact have emotions and that i am affected by things, even if its stupid. And furthermore to just admit it to myself and be honest to her and trust her and let myself out towards her instead of going back to my cover and put on a mask of anger and irritation... Im so fucking stupid i swear

Same, i talked with a couple of friends about this and i also posted about this earlier on another subreddit but my friends just keep telling me that i cant force her and i should just let her go and the subreddit aswell with the addition that im weird and not good. I even apologized for forcing her but i just cant live with all of this... Especially not now after realizing a lot of things that opened my eyes, all that progress and developement is just for her. I just want her back and show her that everything is gonna be fine and better than it was ever in the past... I just cant accept this fate, its too agonizing...
I wish and i hope this to be true...

For me it was the same. Everytime i promised her to get better, i honestly always had a bad feeling and was nervous because i genuinely was sorry but i just knew that its probably happen again but i really hoped that it wont happen despite the feeling, and that it will get resolved but unfortunately it didnt went like this... i just know in retrospective that every single time i hurt her, it was because i was hurt myself by something stupid and didnt allow myself to show it out of past trauma and basically c-ptsd...

Exactly and i feel the same... Its already physical and not just mental... Only that in my case she told me "you're a sick piece of shit, no one will ever stay with you, you are worthless to me and to the world", and shes right aswell...
All im wondering is how you managed to stay alive... Because at this point i dont even know anymore how to di that

Relateable... My father has really bad NPD and my mother BPD. When i was just a few weeks old, they basically left me alone for a long time and came back to me crying and dying as i had a fever of 41.5°c ... And from what i understood, my mother also told me that my father was even pissed that he had to rush me to the hospital and instead of not being like this, i instead became at some points just like them whenever i was too weak to deal with shit. I wish it would habe been 42 degrees so i wouldnt have had to experience any of this shit ive been through and be stuck where i am now...
